videos.title: How to Be More Confident in Yourself/ ​@herdentity
videos.desc:
Are you constantly saying yes to others, even when you’re exhausted?
Do you feel like you’re living a life that isn’t truly yours, putting everyone else first and forgetting yourself?

In this video, we dive deep into how to stop people-pleasing, set healthy boundaries, and build confidence that comes from within. You’ll learn how to:

• Recognize the mask you’ve been wearing without even realizing it
• Start saying no without feeling guilty
• Make decisions that honor your true self
• Build lasting self-worth and emotional strength

This isn’t about motivation,it’s about transformation. 💖
Take the first step today to own your life and become the confident, unapologetic YOU you were meant to be

videos.title: STOP FAKING CONFIDENCE 🛑✋ Here’s What Women Actually Need | Herdentity |Dami Olatunji | 2026
videos.desc:
Confidence is something many women chase, motivation, affirmations, and self-help tips. Yet even after doing everything “right,” something still feels missing.

The truth is simple: confidence without identity is temporary.

In this video, we explore why so many women appear confident on the outside but still feel uncertain inside. When you discover who you truly are your values, purpose, strengths, and boundaries, confidence stops being something you chase. It becomes something natural and unshakable.

At Herdentity, we believe real confidence is built on strong foundations: identity, purpose, limits, mindset, self-leadership, and owning your journey.

If you’ve ever felt like your confidence was just a mask, this message is for you.

✨ Start building your foundation from the inside out.

S- SCRIPTURE
Physically write out the scripture(s) you would like to analyze.

0-OBSERVATION:
Record your observations and interpretations from the scripture.
Look out for common themes, key phrases, repetitions, connectiveness, advice, commands, warning, promises, comparisons, contrasts, illustrations, places / locations, what it says about God, what it says about people, etc.

A-APPLICATION
Reflect on what God is telling you about this verse and write down how you would apply it to your life. When you have applied the lessons, you can come back to check the box on the bottom right. This will help keep you accountable.

P-PRAYER:
Write a prayer on what you learned asking God to help you remember and apply them.

videos.title: IKOGOSI WARM SPRING || THE 8th WONDER OF THE WORLD || 2021|| Dami Oladele
videos.desc:
The Ikogosi Warm Springs is a tourist attraction located at Ikogosi, a town in Ekiti State, southwestern Nigeria. Flowing abreast the warm spring is another cold spring which meets the warm spring at a confluence, each maintaining its thermal properties. These attributes make the spring a tourist attraction in Nigeria. Research suggested that the warm spring has a temperature of about 70oC at the source and 37oC at the confluence.
